title: Distributed Joke System
description: Node.js microservices route joke submissions through RabbitMQ to an Auth0-protected moderation UI, served from MySQL behind a Kong gateway.

title: Rentigo
description: Team-built PHP and MySQL rental platform. I built the tenant side — property search, booking, lease workflows, rent tracking and maintenance views.

title: Becute Dreams Luxe
description: A full-stack sticker boutique on Supabase Postgres: storefront browsing, cart and checkout, plus a role-protected admin dashboard for catalogue and orders.

title: Smart Home Monitoring & Control
description: React Native and Supabase app for real-time device control, scheduling and energy tracking, with interactive floor plans and a companion hardware simulator.

title: Maze to Savor
description: A three-player, turn-based 3D maze game in C. Dice drive movement across floors of walls, stairs and poles, with player capture and loop detection.

title: SensorVault
description: ESP32 monitor publishing DHT11 and LDR readings over MQTT to a live dashboard, with automatic lighting, a heat alarm and AC relay control.

title: Lawyers Management System
description: A legal practice front end on React 19 and Vite, with client, lawyer and admin workspaces for lawyer search, appointments, case tracking and verification.

title: Mini C Interpreter
description: A recursive-descent parser and interpreter in C for a minimal language: int declarations, print() statements, arithmetic precedence and line-numbered errors.

title: GIT Happens
description: A Next.js delivery operations front end with dispatcher, driver, loader and store-manager workspaces for live tracking, planning and exception handling.

title: Movie App
description: A React and Vite app for browsing popular films and searching the TMDB catalogue, with a favourites list kept in React context.
